```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  lint-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8

      - name: Run black
        run: |
          black --check .

      - name: Run isort
        run: |
          isort --check-only .

      - name: Run flake8
        run: |
          flake8 .

  lint-cpp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install clang-format
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y clang-format

      - name: Run clang-format
        run: |
          find . -name "*.cu" -exec clang-format -style=file -Werror --dry-run {} +

  lint-mojo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate Mojo files
        run: |
          # Basic validation for Mojo files
          find . -name "*.mojo" -exec sh -c '
            for file; do
              if ! grep -q "@export" "$file"; then
                echo "Error: Mojo file $file missing @export decorator"
                exit 1
              fi
              if ! grep -q "import" "$file"; then
                echo "Warning: Mojo file $file may be missing standard imports"
              fi
            done
          ' sh {} +
```
